fee_notes: Royalty is 4.0% of Gross Sales, paid each Tuesday; franchisor may increase royalty up to 18% during breach/default. Marketing Fee is currently 1% of Gross Sales, can be increased by up to 0.5% per year with 60 days notice. Local Marketing is an additional 1% of Gross Sales, with a combined maximum of 3% for both marketing and local marketing. After at least one full fiscal year of operation, franchisee may prepay royalty annually and receive a 10% discount. Technology Support Fees range from $200 to $325 per month (midpoint used: $262.50). Gross Sales exclude tips, sales tax, loyalty redemptions, Free Pie Wednesdays discounts, senior discounts, delivery fees, and other customary promotions or discounts.
